title: Travel Protection, Club Earning and Corporate Booking by Vacation Package Product
content:
Beside its own terms each of the Vacation Package Products carries a position on three things the traveller may hold elsewhere in the house: whether travel protection must be held for the package to be confirmed, the discount on a travel protection premium bought together with the package, the percentage of the package price that accrues as Wanderlane Traveller Club points, and whether the product may be booked under a corporate travel programme at all.

| Product | Travel protection required | Bundled protection discount | Club points earn rate | Corporate programme booking |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | not required | 5 per cent | 50 per cent of the package price | not accepted |
| Flex Bundle Package | not required | 8 per cent | 75 per cent of the package price | not accepted |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | not required | 10 per cent | 100 per cent of the package price | not accepted |
| Escorted Tour Package | required | 12 per cent | 100 per cent of the package price | not accepted |
| Ocean Cruise Package | required | 12 per cent | 125 per cent of the package price | not accepted |
| Luxury Collection Package | required | 20 per cent | 200 per cent of the package price | accepted |

## How the three sit against one another

The requirement to hold travel protection attaches to the three highest-ranked products alone: the Escorted Tour Package, the Ocean Cruise Package and the Luxury Collection Package. The discount on a protection premium bought together with the package rises steadily across all six, from 5 per cent to 20 per cent, and is published whether or not protection is required.

The club points earn rate is expressed as a percentage of the package price and reaches 100 per cent on both the All-Inclusive Resort Package and the Escorted Tour Package before rising to 125 per cent and then 200 per cent. The Luxury Collection Package is the one product of the six that a corporate travel programme may book at all.
